article.dek: The Nifty 50 closed at 22,749.75. NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, breadth, top movers and FII/DII flows.

visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: 27 October provisional cash flows, ₹ crore, as reported by Trendlyne and corroborated with Moneycontrol. Gross purchases/sales are on the FII/DII data page.

reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 fell 0.02%; 352 of 501 Nifty 500 stocks advanced.
reportWatch: Watch the next session’s exchange filings and the direction of crude prices. Current options open-interest changes, PCR and contract expiry were not sufficiently verified for this report.
body: The Nifty 50 fell 3.45 points, or 0.02%, to close at 22,749.75 on Tuesday, 27 October 2026, according to NSE closing data. The Sensex fell 0.01% to 73,598.67. Bank Nifty lost 0.72% to 53,974.90.

Why the market moved | Interpretation: the nearly flat headline index concealed stronger participation in smaller stocks. Banks and IT declined, while media, realty and pharma advanced. These sector moves describe market performance; they do not establish a single cause.

More data | Scroll up for the full NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, Nifty 500 breadth, top gainers and losers and FII/DII flows. For more, see the Nifty 50 page and the FII/DII data page on TotalMarket.

Institutional activity | Provisional net cash flows are now available for this session, as reported by Trendlyne and corroborated with Moneycontrol. They replace the earlier unavailable reading; cash flows do not cover all foreign investment categories.
